title: A MapReduce Approach to Effectively Utilize Long Context Information in Retrieval Augmented Language Models
authors: Gongbo Zhang; Zihan Xu; Qiao Jin; Fangyi Chen; Yilu Fang; Yi Liu; Justin F. Rousseau; Ziyang Xu; Zhiyong Lu; Chunhua Weng; Yifan Peng
why_relevant: Proposes a map-reduce RAG framework to mitigate lost-in-the-middle and irrelevant context distraction, with analysis of conflicting context resolution and a preflight check to decide when extra processing is needed.
why_not_or_caveat: Focused on medical QA application; not a central robustness study.
